title: calliandra inermis subsp. alamosensis
intro: Calliandra inermis subsp. alamosensis, commonly known as the Alamos Calliandra, is a flowering plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, and its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra inermis subsp. alamosensis include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
